summary: The Student Orientations module appears to handle interactions related to student orientation procedures. It involves functionality for adding, editing, and deleting student orientation records, customizing the user interface based on user roles, and handling data related to agency sites and provider types. The module also manages data bindings and interactions with web controls like dropdowns, buttons, and panels.
purpose: Facilitate the management of student orientation records within the system, allowing authorized users to add, edit, and delete records while ensuring proper data validation and access control.
